project.title: Restaurant wastewater Targeted Locus (Loci)
project.description: High-throughput pyrosequencing in this study to reveal bacterial pathogen diversity in a full-scale membrane bioreactor (MBR) treating restaurant wastewater.  Influent wastewater, activated sludge and treated wastewater samples, termed as A1, A2 and A3 samples (V1~V3 of 16S rRNA gene), were taken from the inlet pipe, aerobic tank and outlet pipe of a membrane bioreactor treating restaurant wastewater

samples: V1~V3 of 16S rRNA gene isolated from activated sludge of an MBR treating restaurant wastewater
V1~V3 of 16S rRNA gene isolated from influent wastewater of an MBR treating restaurant wastewater
V1~V3 of 16S rRNA gene isolated from treated wastewater of an MBR treating restaurant wastewater
